learning_outcomes.text: Ability to analyze and interpret experimental results
Ability to use laboratory equipment and knowledge of laboratory standards
Ability to work productively as part of a team, ability to give and receive instructions
Ability to generate solutions for basic process problems based on scientific and practical thinking
Initiative, organizational, and time management skills

syllabus_topics: Investigation of Shell and Tube Heat Exchanger
Determination of Heat of Solution by Solubility Method
Conductometric Titration of Hydrochloric Acid and Acetic Acid with Sodium Hydroxide
